## computeColumnTicks() function

Ticks for the discrete columns currently visible in a panned/zoomed viewport — the MSA case, where one unit is one column of fixed pixel width. Major ticks carry a 1-based label; minor ticks (five per major where the step allows) do not. Positions are 1-based for the user, so the label `50` sits on column index 49.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function computeColumnTicks(input: {
    columnCount: number;
    width: number;
    offsetX: number;
    pixelsPerColumn: number;
    minSpacing?: number;
}): Tick[];
```
